errors.text: The targeted property is misidentified as intrinsic stacking-fault energy; the hidden target concerns improving magnetic coercivity in fcc Fe-Co-Ni-derived high-entropy alloys.
The proposed material is a single-phase Cantor-type alloy rather than the dual-phase FeCoNiTi alloy containing ferromagnetic fcc and C14 Laves phases.
The response omits the central result that coercivity exceeds the approximately 100 Oe single-phase limit and reaches about 667 Oe at 400 K.

The proposed longitudinal-spin-fluctuation and magnetic-entropy mechanism does not match the target mechanism involving fcc/C14 coexistence, Ti-sublattice antiferromagnetic coupling, spin canting, and domain-wall pinning.

The cited evidence addresses stacking-fault energetics in CoCrFeMnNi and provides no direct support for the asserted importance of orbital moments to magnetic entropy or for the target coercivity mechanism.
